sentences.text:
Ataulla S/O Asloop vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jp:34516) on
14 August, 2024
Author: Ganesh Ram Meena

[2024:RJ-JP:34516]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 9999/2024 Ataulla S/o Asloop, Aged About 41 Years, R/o Village Ladlaka,
Police Station Kaman, District Deeg (Rajasthan). (At Present Confined In Sub Jail, Deeg).
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through PP  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Hemendra Goyal For Respondent(s) : Mr. Chandra Gupt Chopra, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GANESH RAM MEENA  Order 14/08/2024 1.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN  BENCH AT JAIPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This bail application has been filed by the petitioner under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 arising out of FIR No.284/2024, registered with the Police Station Kaman,
District Deeg for the offences under Sections 147, 149, 365, 323 & 341 of IPC.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been roped in this criminal case based on false and fabricated story.

Counsel further submits that the present case has been lodged by the complainant party so as to create pressure upon the accused party to compromise in a criminal case lodged by the sister of the present petitioner on 03.12.2022 at Police Station Kaman bearing FIR No.774/2022 for offences under Sections 323, 341, 354B, 376, 406 & 498A wherein after conclusion of the investigation, the police has submitted charge-sheet against the complainant party.

Counsel further submits that the petitioner is [2024:RJ-JP:34516] (2 of 2)
[CRLMB-9999/2024] forty one (41) years of age and he is behind the bars since 24.06.2024,
therefore, he may be released on bail.
3.
Learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the State has vehemently opposed the bail application and submits that specific allegations have been levelled against the petitioner.

entities.text: Ataulla S/O Asloop vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jp:34516)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considered the submissions made by learned Public Prosecutor as well as the counsel appearing for the respective parties.

5. Taking into consideration the allegations levelled against the petitioner, so also the fact that co-accused Asloop @ Isloop has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide its order dated 19.07.2024 passed in S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 8282/2024, this Court without expressing any opinion on the merit and demerits of the case, deems just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

entities.text: S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 8282/2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
6. This bail application is, accordingly, allowed and it is directed that accused-petitioner shall be released on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac only) together with two sureties in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each to the satisfaction of the trial Court with the stipulation that he shall appear before that Court or any other Court to which the matter is transferred, on all subsequent dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(GANESH RAM MEENA),J DIVYA SAINI /46 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
